description: WGS84 longitude of the AOI centroid, derived from the bounding rectangle defined in EPSG:3577 and reprojected to EPSG:4326.
notes: Constant across all rows. Identifies the spatial location of the 1 km² pixel.

description: WGS84 latitude of the AOI centroid, derived from the bounding rectangle defined in EPSG:3577 and reprojected to EPSG:4326.
notes: Constant across all rows. Negative values indicate the Southern Hemisphere.

description: Calendar year of the observation. Null for the time-invariant DEM row.
notes: Values are 2012 or 2025 for NDVI rows; null for the DEM row.

description: Calendar month of the observation (1 = January, 12 = December). Null for the time-invariant DEM row.
notes: Null for the DEM row. Each month corresponds to a mean of all 32-day composites whose start date falls within that calendar month.

description: Identifier string indicating which GEE ImageCollection the row's data were derived from.
notes: One of two fixed string values; can be used as a grouping factor.

description: Mean bare-earth elevation across all valid 5 m DEM pixels within the AOI.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows.

description: Standard deviation of bare-earth elevation across all valid 5 m DEM pixels within the AOI.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows. Reflects local topographic variability.

description: Minimum bare-earth elevation value among all valid 5 m DEM pixels within the AOI.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows.

description: Maximum bare-earth elevation value among all valid 5 m DEM pixels within the AOI.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows.

description: Median bare-earth elevation across all valid 5 m DEM pixels within the AOI.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows.

description: Number of valid (non-masked) 5 m DEM pixels used in the zonal statistics computation.
notes: Null for all NDVI rows. Can be used to assess data coverage.

description: Mean NDVI across all valid 30 m Landsat pixels within the AOI, computed from the mean of all 32-day composites within the specified month and year.
notes: Null for the DEM row. Values near 1 indicate dense green vegetation; values near 0 or below indicate bare soil, water, or non-vegetated surfaces.

description: Standard deviation of NDVI across all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI for the given month and year.
notes: Null for the DEM row. Reflects spatial heterogeneity in vegetation cover.

description: Minimum NDVI value among all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI for the given month and year.
notes: Null for the DEM row.

description: Maximum NDVI value among all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI for the given month and year.
notes: Null for the DEM row.

description: Median NDVI across all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI for the given month and year.
notes: Null for the DEM row.

description: Number of valid (non-masked) 30 m Landsat pixels used in the NDVI zonal statistics computation.
notes: Null for the DEM row. Low counts may indicate cloud contamination or missing composites.

description: Mean pixel-wise NDVI difference (2025 minus 2012) for the corresponding calendar month, averaged across all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI.
notes: Populated only for year == 2025 rows. Positive values indicate greening; negative values indicate vegetation decline relative to 2012.

description: Standard deviation of the pixel-wise NDVI difference (2025 minus 2012) for the corresponding calendar month across all valid 30 m pixels within the AOI.
notes: Populated only for year == 2025 rows.

description: Minimum pixel-wise NDVI difference (2025 minus 2012) for the corresponding calendar month within the AOI.
notes: Populated only for year == 2025 rows.

description: Maximum pixel-wise NDVI difference (2025 minus 2012) for the corresponding calendar month within the AOI.
notes: Populated only for year == 2025 rows.
